card.name: Dose or power word before an amount
card.fires_on: Nouns like dose, dosage and power (also 'long' or 'of' in duration phrases) right before a number or amount is given. It appears in dosing instructions and in laser power settings.

modes.label: Dose or dosage noun
modes.description: The word dose or dosage right after 'recommended' or 'induction', before the amount.
modes.example: The recommended induction<< dosage>> of RINVOQ is 4

modes.label: Laser power or energy
modes.description: The word power after laser or energy, before a value or unit.
modes.example: slowly increasing the laser<< power>>. (mw) Treatment Time (sec

modes.label: Duration phrases
modes.description: Words like long, of or for in phrases about how long a treatment lasts.
modes.example: three times daily for as<< long>> as two weeks.
